Find out more about the Littleover and Blagreaves Safer Neighbourhood Team on Derbyshire Constabulary's website. Littleover Neighbourhood Board The forum/board: leads on behalf of the whole neighbourhood agrees on the priorities for the neighbourhood decides where delegated Council budgets are to be spent monitors performance influences decisions that reflect the views of local residents decides on the vision for your neighbourhood The Neighbourhood Board received a budget from October 2019 and will receive a further budget from April 2020. This budget is to enable voluntary and community groups (non-commercial) to apply for funding for projects or events, that will both benefit and enable the community and its residents. If you would be interested in putting together a funding application for consideration by the board, ‌please read the guidance and complete the form: ‌Board Funding Application 2022/23 Neighbourhood board devolved budget funding guidance Members of Littleover Neighbourhood Board Chair - Councillor Care Councillor Atwal Councillor Lonsdale Littleover Neighbourhood Forum If you would like to raise an issue or require more information, contact one of your local Councillors: Chair - Councillor Care Councillor Atwal Councillor Lonsdale Next forum meeting Heatherton Community Centre, Hollybrook Way, 7pm, 7 December 2022 Ward Walkabouts Ward walkabouts is an initiative to strengthen community spirit and build safer communities. This involves councillors, Neighbourhoods, Derby Homes and the Police, together with local residents leading a high profile and visible patrol. The idea behind this is to get back to traditional community values of local people looking out for each other and identifying any problems raised in the area. We will litter pick, greet and listen so come along and join us. For further information please telephone Jonathan Till on 01332 888725 .
